subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “History is not always pleasant music.”?
options: Instead of only telling people where to walk, the city studied where people already walked and built a better way.
Sometimes a place changes not because it becomes larger or newer, but because it gives people time to stop.
Sometimes it is a harsh sound that reminds people of labor, discipline, and the lives behind the products a town was built on.
The town showed that sometimes less allows people to see more.
